rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: Appliances shouldn’t be boring. The Insignia NS-MWR07M2 0.7 Cu. Ft. Retro Compact Microwave adds a retro touch to your space with a pop of mint color everyone will notice. The retro design includes a round viewing window and chrome details that will take you back in time. With 700 W of power and a .7 cu. ft. interior, reheat meals or prepare yourself a snack with a touch of a button. Nine preset cooking functions, ten power levels and a defrost setting grant you ideal heating options for any type of dish. Control it all with a simple and straight-forward digital LED display and control knob. A removable 10 in. glass turntable ensures that your food is evenly heated and also makes cleaning the inside of the microwave easy to do. Offering flexible placement options, this Insignia compact microwave can go on your countertop or kitchen rack, ready to heat your meals while adding a retro touch to your décor.

700 W Of Microwave Cooking

  • Cook or reheat meat, vegetables, pasta and more at the touch of a button.

Retro Design

  • Mint color, round viewing window and chrome details provide a fun retro touch.

.7 Cu. Ft. Interior

  • Reheat small portions or cook a snack.

Digital Led Display With Control Knob

  • Easy to operate and control.

Compact Construction

  • Place it on your countertop or kitchen cart while the 3.3 ft. (1 m) cord reaches to an outlet.

Nine Preset Cooking Functions

  • Cook your favorites with ease.

Ten Power Levels

  • Heat your food to your exact preference.

Integrated Cooking Light

  • Check your items as they are heating to prevent overcooking or burning.

Removable 10 In. (25.5 Cm) Glass Turntable

  • Automatically rotates to evenly heat food and provides easy cleaning.

Defrost Setting

  • Thaw frozen items according to their weight.

Lock Function

  • Prevent children from changing your microwave settings.

Eco Mode

  • Conserve electricity and save money.
